cards.ex: The car accelerated sharply as it entered the highway.
cards.exUz: Mashina trassaga kirishi bilan keskin tezlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Tezlikni birdaniga va juda ko'p oshirish, tezlikning keskin ortishi.

cards.ex: We dawdled along the riverbank, enjoying the scenery.
cards.exUz: Biz daryo bo'ylab sekin yurib, manzaradan zavqlanardik.
cards.uzDef: Juda sekin va qiziqishsiz yurish, vaqtni cho'zish.

cards.ex: Our competitor is losing ground in the market due to poor service.
cards.exUz: Raqobatchimiz yomon xizmat ko'rsatgani uchun bozorda o'z o'rnini yo'qotmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tezlik yoki taraqqiyotni yo'qotish, orqada qolish.

cards.ex: The new regulations were swiftly implemented after the incident.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar hodisadan keyin tezda amalga oshirildi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va samarali tarzda amalga oshirilgan yoki joriy etilgan.

cards.ex: Progress on the project is moving at a snail's gallop.
cards.exUz: Loyiha bo'yicha taraqqiyot juda sekin olg'a siljimoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'ta sekin harakatlanish, juda past tezlikda.

cards.ex: The campaign is starting to gather momentum as more people get involved.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya ko'proq odamlar ishtirok etishi bilan kuchayishni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Tezlik yoki ta'sirning ortib borishi, avj olish.

cards.ex: In this emergency situation, time is of the essence.
cards.exUz: Favqulodda vaziyatda vaqt juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt juda muhim yoki shoshilinch ekanligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: We need to slow the pace of development to ensure sustainability.
cards.exUz: Barqarorlikni ta'minlash uchun rivojlanish tempini sekinlashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezlikni yoki harakatni kamaytirish, sekinroq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We did a whirlwind tour of Europe in just two weeks.
cards.exUz: Biz atigi ikki hafta ichida Yevropa bo'ylab tezkor sayohat qildik.
cards.uzDef: Tez va qisqa muddatli sayohat, hamma joyga ulgurish uchun.

cards.ex: The teacher hurried the students along so they wouldn't be late.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi talabalarni kechikmasliklari uchun shoshiltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishini tezroq harakat qilishga undash, shoshiltirish.

cards.ex: We're trying to expedite the process of getting your visa approved.
cards.exUz: Biz sizning vizangizni tasdiqlash jarayonini tezlashtirishga harakat qilyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Jarayonni tezroq bajarish, tezlashtirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Her English has improved in leaps and bounds since she started taking classes.
cards.exUz: U darslarga qatnashishni boshlaganidan beri uning ingliz tili katta qadamlar bilan yaxshilandi.
cards.uzDef: Juda tez va katta miqdorda rivojlanish yoki yaxshilanish.

cards.ex: With the deadline approaching, we need to shift into high gear.
cards.exUz: Muddat yaqinlashar ekan, biz yuqori tezlikka o'tishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq va tez ishlashga o'tish, jadallashmoq.

cards.ex: We decided to take a leisurely pace and enjoy the hike.
cards.exUz: Biz sekin yurishga va sayohatdan zavqlanishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Shoshilmasdan, qulay va sekin tempda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Technology is advancing at warp speed these days.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya bugungi kunda juda tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'ta tez tezlikda, juda tez bajariladigan narsa.

cards.ex: This is just a quick fix; we need a permanent solution.
cards.exUz: Bu shunchaki tezkor yechim; bizga doimiy yechim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni tez va oson hal qilish, ammo doimiy emas.

cards.ex: The company is dragging its feet on implementing the new safety regulations.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi xavfsizlik qoidalarini joriy etishda sekinlashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ishni sekinlashtirish, xohishsiz yoki ehtiyotsiz harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The new product is gaining ground quickly in the market.
cards.exUz: Yangi mahsulot bozorda tezda o'z o'rnini egallamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tezlik bilan muvaffaqiyatga erishish, tezda oldinga siljish.

cards.ex: The negotiations have seen stop-start progress over the past few months.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar so'nggi oylarda to'xtab-boshlash taraqqiyotini ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Olg'a siljishning to'xtab qolishi va yana boshlanishi.

cards.ex: The factory is ramping up production to meet the increased demand.
cards.exUz: Fabrika ortib borayotgan talabni qondirish uchun ishlab chiqarishni oshirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ishlab chiqarish hajmini oshirish, ishlab chiqarishni ko'paytirish.

cards.ex: The project was completed in record time thanks to the team's dedication.
cards.exUz: Loyiha jamoaning fidoyiligi tufayli rekord vaqt ichida yakunlandi.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan ancha tezroq, juda tez vaqt ichida.

cards.ex: He's a slow starter, but once he gets going, he's unstoppable.
cards.exUz: U sekin boshlovchi, ammo boshlaganidan keyin uni to'xtatib bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ishni boshlashda sekin, keyin esa tezlashadigan odam.

cards.ex: The project is currently behind schedule due to unforeseen delays.
cards.exUz: Loyiha hozirda kutilmagan kechikishlar tufayli belgilangan vaqtdan orqada qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan vaqtdan kechroq, vaqt jadvalidan ortda qolish.

cards.ex: The team went into overdrive to finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: Jamoa loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun juda tez ish olib bordi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq ishlash, haddan tashqari kuch bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get up to speed with the new software.
cards.exUz: Menga yangi dasturiy ta'minot bilan ishlashni o'rganish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Joriy holatni tushunish, kerakli tezlikka erishish.

cards.ex: The negotiations seemed to be marking time, with no real progress being made.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar hech qanday real taraqqiyotga erishilmagan holda joyida tepinayotgandek tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday taraqqiyot qilmaslik, joyida qotib qolish.

cards.ex: Momentum is building for the reform, with growing public support.
cards.exUz: Islohot uchun kuchayish bormoqda, jamoatchilikning qo'llab-quvvatlashi ortib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jarayonning tezligi va ta'siri ortib bormoqda.

cards.ex: The company is gaining ground steadily in the international market.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya xalqaro bozorda doimiy ravishda o'z o'rnini egallab bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy va bosqichma-bosqich muvaffaqiyatga erishish, o'z o'rnini topish.

cards.ex: The athlete showed a flash of speed as he sprinted to the finish line.
cards.exUz: Sportchi finish chizig'iga sprint qilayotganda tezligini namoyish etdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va kutilmagan harakat, qisqa vaqt ichida tezlashish.

cards.ex: We're starting to get behind schedule on this project.
cards.exUz: Biz ushbu loyihada belgilangan vaqtdan orqada qola boshladik.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan vaqtdan kechroq bo'lish, belgilangan vaqtni o'tkazib yuborish.
